messages:
Ethan (AE): Heads upAuroraEdge CISO paused POC. Wants a one-page exec note + minimal runbook proving no uncontrolled outbound egress and 90d log export. Need by Fri AM.
Sam (SE): Understood. Do they need Dedicated or will hosted+retention suffice?
Ethan (AE): They prefer hosted for speed but will accept Dedicated if security requires. CISO asked for explicit acceptance criteria.
Mei (Security): Hosted can deliver per-request logs; 90d export needs retention addon. Blocking arbitrary outbound domains requires network isolation (Dedicated/Private) or customer-side proxy.
Jordan (Infra): We can reserve static NAT IPs (INFRA-8001) and provide inbound allowlist. Timeline: Thu morning if INFRA-8001 is prioritized.
Sam (SE): I'll draft a one-page runbook: inbound CIDRs, what we can/can't block, log export steps, rollback steps. Short and copyable for their security deck.
Ethan (AE): Also need legal-ready phrasing re: liability for outbound traffic during POC.
Mei (Security): Suggested line: "Redwood provides network controls as described; customers and Redwood validate egress behavior during POC."
Jordan (Infra): clippy-bot, please open ticket for NAT IP reservation.
clippy-bot: Created INFRA-8001 for static NAT reservation, assigned infra-oncall.
Sam (SE): Draft runbook posted: 
- Example allowlist: 18.197.34.0/24, 3.210.12.0/24
- Steps: verify INFRA-8001 -> customer allows inbound -> run egress test -> export logs (90d) -> validate sample CSV
- Rollback: revert ACLs, switch to stable model pool, notify infra-oncall
Ethan (AE): Perfect. Mei/Jordan/Jordan please drop final exec note + INFRA-8001 link here and I'll send to their CISO.
Mei (Security): Exec note posted: Hosted+retention = faster; Dedicated = stronger network guarantees. Recommended: start hosted with retention if timeline critical, plan Dedicated migration if CISO still not satisfied.
Ethan (AE): Thanks team. Sending to AuroraEdge once INFRA-8001 confirmed. :shipit:
